record.paper: The crossing number of the cone of a graph

dossier_meta.paper: The crossing number of the cone of a graph
dossier_meta.context_text: Section 5 proves $f_s(k) = k + o(k)$ for simple graphs, improving on the upper bound $f_s(k) \leq 2k$ suggested by small cases ($f_s(1)=3,\, f_s(2)=5,\, f_s(3)=6,\, f_s(4)=8,\, f_s(5)=10$). The authors provide additional justification for this more precise asymptotic conjecture on the simple-graph version of $f$.
